catalog.scope: Warsaw pilot catalog. Restaurant discovery includes every OSM amenity=restaurant feature returned by the recorded Overpass snapshot, with separately curated records taking precedence over duplicate OSM entries.
catalog.location_method: Restaurant discovery generated from OpenStreetMap Overpass snapshot 2026-10-04; curated venue facts keep their per-field sources.
catalog.taste_note: taste_tags on non-Qloo discovery rows are deterministic fixture heuristics used only when live Qloo is inactive. They are not venue claims and are not Qloo output.
